design_fault.contract: The independently initialized full June/July forward must remain exactly equal to the pragmatic paired-month anchor, including its already disclosed marginal July loss.
design_fault.incorrect_implementation: The exact-neutral gate reused the selection all-period-positive helper and therefore required June and July each to be positive.
design_fault.reason_no_verdict: The frozen pragmatic anchor accepts the small July loss from a positive full forward. Requiring July positivity contradicts the declaration and is a design error, not candidate economics.

correction.change: Require exact candidate/control equality for full, June and July period nets, no state/path divergence, zero candidate skips and positive capital; do not require the already accepted July slice itself to be profitable.
